name: Wasako Japanese-Style Room (Asakusa)
editor_note: Sixty minutes in a Japanese-style room steps from Asakusa Station, with a choice of tatami or chairs. Platform-only operator we haven't verified first-hand.
price_note: from ¥7,000 per person per a GetYourGuide-powered listing (jasumo.com), read 2026-11-03. Not yet confirmed on GetYourGuide itself.
notes: 5F Collection Kaminarimon Building, 2-18-15 Kaminarimon. Near Asakusa Station Exit A4.
